claim_scope: A clear complete Art Nouveau decorative-panel composition: figure, hair, garment contours, vines and enclosing field act together. One panel and digital version; not every Art Nouveau medium.
limits: The original design is documented, but this reproduction does not authenticate a particular surviving print or its color accuracy. Other editions, paper, printing process details and the rest of the four-panel set were not inspected. Narrow cream margins and the signature belong to the published work; no mounting inventory label or gallery setting appears.
observable_features: The complete tall panel and rounded enclosing outline fill the image, without mounting creases, inventory labels or neighboring works.
The curving figure and draped garment connect to elongated hair loops and vine tendrils across the field.
Dark continuous contours simplify the figure and foliage into related directional bands rather than isolated botanical decorations.
Poppy flowers at the head, trailing vines and water-edge curves link the upper figure to the lower composition.

association_evidence.supports: The exact Commons record identifies the 1896 Summer panel, supplies these exact reproduction bytes and identifies them as public domain. It does not establish a specific physical impression’s provenance.

The Mucha Foundation identifies Summer as an 1896 color lithographic panel, describes the poppies, grapevine and shallow water, and situates the Seasons panels in Mucha’s decorative poster practice. It is used for work/design facts, not to license this different Commons image.

confusion_check.shared_appearances: Flowers, women and decorative borders occur in many illustration traditions.
confusion_check.discriminating_relationships: The figure, hair, drapery, vine loops and enclosing contour share sinuous directions throughout the composition. Those linked lines are stronger evidence than the presence of flowers or a pale palette alone; compare Art Deco’s stepped/radiating geometric coordination separately.
confusion_check.cannot_conclude: This panel cannot authenticate a new print, establish the whole movement from one motif, or prove a newly supplied designer’s actual influences.
